description:
Revenue Orchestration Tools-B2B brings more than 370 marketing and sales tools from NuSpark Marketing's AI Growth Accelerator into ChatGPT. Paul Mosenson, a B2B marketer with more than 30 years in media, lead generation and revenue growth, built each tool to handle one job step by step.

Open a tool by name and it walks you through the work one question at a time, or you can attach documents about your business to go faster. Tools cover go-to-market planning, ideal customer profiles, ad copy, AI search visibility, content, email and funnels, LinkedIn and personalized outreach, lead magnets, paid search and SEO, media planning, SaaS growth, sales enablement, social media, and website and landing page improvements.

Not sure where to start? Browse the full list by category at nusparkmarketing.com/ai-growth-accelerator/, then type the tool's name in ChatGPT. For hands-on help, contact Paul through the website.
